title: French Senate to launch inquiry commission on cyberattacks and data leaks, senator Goulet says
date_note: Goulet spoke on Wednesday 25 November per the article published that day.
summary: Senator Nathalie Goulet (UDI) said on Wednesday 25 November that the Senate will launch an inquiry commission on cyberattacks and data leaks "dans les prochains jours", franceinfo reports. It would review attacks and leaks of the past three years affecting administrations, operators of vital importance and French companies, and look at ANSSI's response capacity. The inquiry would run six months, with a report expected in April or May 2027.
plain: A French senator says the Senate will open an inquiry into cyberattacks and data leaks of the past three years. It would run six months, with a report expected in April or May 2027.
exec: A French Senate inquiry, running six months, will review cyberattacks and data leaks of the past three years, per franceinfo.
geo_basis: agency: the French Senate, which announced the inquiry; the articles give no other place
